fields.title: Handling forms
fields.description: Give a brick an action: its form works without JavaScript, and with it only the brick updates.

data.title: The data comes from storage, not the form
data.body: A `<ActionForm>` names its entry (collection, document and entry id), never its data. The server reads the entry and passes its stored `data` to the action, so a visitor can't change what the editor set. An editable "Send to" address is safe for that reason.

data.title: Spam
data.body: The example adds a hidden honeypot field (a bot fills it in, and the action answers "sent" without sending) and a per-client limit with `createLimiter` in the server function. For a busy form, add a CAPTCHA and verify its token in the action.
